policy: A HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerability blocks only while a vendor fix exists that has not been taken. Findings with no vendor fixed version are accepted by owner policy (2026-10-18). A finding whose fix exists upstream, but whose vendor has not shipped it in a release, is accepted only by a record below: owner-approved, bound to the exact image digest and expiring within 31 days. See security/accepted-risk.md.
